races.name: Frodon & Black Corton At Taunton Novices' Hurdle (Novices' Championship Hurdle Qualifier) (GBB)

runners_data.name: Secret Sniper
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with highest RPR rating but needs the pace to collapse to be effective from the rear

runners_data.name: Itsinthename
runners_data.note: Back marker who improved last time and has shown he can win when getting the right pace setup

runners_data.name: Minella Yoga
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning after 75-day break for Paul Nicholls, perfectly positioned to control this small field

runners_data.name: Lau And Shaz
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with course-winning amateur Newman who knows the horse well and can track the leader

runners_data.name: Regal Icon
runners_data.note: Another prominent type but has been off 84 days and lacks recent form to assess current wellbeing

runners_data.name: Corsican Caper
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs a strong pace but trainer Kevin Frost is in decent form recently

runners_data.name: Hawa Jumeirah
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner who looks outclassed despite having some good going form at lesser levels

races.paceDynamic: Minella Yoga will set the early tempo from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this seven-runner field. The Paul Nicholls runner should get an uncontested lead with Lau And Shaz and Regal Icon settling in behind, while the four hold-up horses (Secret Sniper, Itsinthename, Corsican Caper, Hawa Jumeirah) drop out the back. This creates a moderate gallop early before the pace quickens approaching the business end. The lack of pace pressure and small field clearly favours the prominent runners who can track the leader without being bustled along.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Minella Yoga Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Minella Yoga gets an easy lead and quickens decisively approaching two out.
scenarios.body: The proven front-runner has the class edge and Paul Nicholls' 75-day break suggests he's been aimed at this. His style perfectly suits the likely scenario of getting first run on the field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Lau And Shaz or Regal Icon press Minella Yoga turning for home creating a strong gallop.
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out the front-runner's stamina reserves after his break. Amateur jockey Newman knows Lau And Shaz well and this trip suits perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and one of the back markers produces a sustained finish.
scenarios.body: Secret Sniper has the highest RPR and Itsinthename showed improved form last time out. The light weight helps both in a finish decided by raw ability rather than positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Minella Yoga stops quickly and the prominent horses also empty approaching the last.
scenarios.body: This becomes a sprint finish where any of the field could nick it. The small field means positioning becomes less critical than stamina reserves.

watchPoints.text: Minella Yoga must handle the 75-day layoff as Paul Nicholls runners can need their first run back
Lau And Shaz with amateur Newman could make a tactical error if pressing too early against the class leader
Secret Sniper needs to be much closer than usual given the lack of pace in this small field
Regal Icon returning after 84 days with question marks over current form and fitness levels
Early pace will be crucial - if Minella Yoga goes too slow the hold-up horses become dangerous

races.name: C&D South West Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Noble Blue
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with highest RPR of 106 but 5lb claimer Joshua Newman may struggle tactically in this pace-less scenario.

runners_data.name: Gasmani
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but 110 days off track is a concern despite David Dennis having decent recent strike-rate.

runners_data.name: Happy Returns
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good recent form with protective headgear, Neil Mulholland's 4-from-26 record shows he gets them fit.

runners_data.name: Saint Polo
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suited to expected lack of pace, recent second at this distance bodes well.

runners_data.name: Marhaba Million
runners_data.note: Another hold-up runner who should benefit from tactical scenario, first-time tongue-tie may sharpen him up.

races.paceDynamic: With Jessmae declared as non-runner, this becomes a pace-less affair with no genuine front-runners among the remaining six. Noble Blue, Gasmani and Happy Returns will all look to take prominent positions early, likely creating a moderate tempo over this 3m trip at Taunton. The lack of natural pace-setters means the early gallop will be steady rather than searching, allowing the field to stay compact through the middle stages before a tactical finish develops. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, particularly Saint Polo and Marhaba Million who thrive when able to unleash finishing efforts from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian with no horse willing to commit early
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace allows Saint Polo and Marhaba Million to be perfectly positioned turning for home, where their superior finishing kicks prove decisive. The prominent racers find themselves going too slow early and lack the acceleration to respond when the hold-up horses pounce.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Noble Blue and Happy Returns engage in a sustained battle for the lead from halfway
scenarios.body: The increased tempo from 2f out stretches the field and prevents the hold-up horses from getting into contention. Noble Blue's higher class tells in a driving finish with Happy Returns, while the backmarkers are left with too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Gasmani Finds Improvement
scenarios.trigger: If trainer David Dennis has Gasmani spot-on after 110 days off and the pace collapse suits
scenarios.body: Gasmani's prominent style allows him to capitalise when the leaders fold, staying on strongly up the hill while the hold-up horses meet traffic problems in a bunched finish. His trainer's 2-from-7 recent record suggests he can find the necessary improvement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all the prominent runners go too steady and kick simultaneously at the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery with the entire field in contention turning in, favouring whichever horse finds the clearest passage and gets first run. Noble Blue's higher rating gives him the edge in a blanket finish where class rather than tactics proves decisive.

watchPoints.text: Noble Blue may struggle if Joshua Newman gets involved in early pace battles rather than waiting.
Happy Returns has been pulled up recently so stamina over this 3m trip remains questionable.
Saint Polo needs the leaders to go steady early to be effective from his hold-up style.
Marhaba Million's first-time tongue-tie could either improve him significantly or unsettle his jumping rhythm.
Gasmani's long absence means his fitness levels are completely unknown despite recent workout reports.

races.name: Tony & Carole Stocker Anniversary Surprise Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Just A Heartbeat
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with experienced jockey but 154 days off and poor recent form suggest rustiness will hinder chances

runners_data.name: Miracles Do Happen
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist from in-form Tom Lacey yard with decent recent run but lacks a win in 14 starts over hurdles

runners_data.name: Bluenose Belle
runners_data.note: Patient hold-up mare with strong recent form including two wins, carries least weight and has proven course effectiveness

runners_data.name: Dance Havana
runners_data.note: Prominent runner dropping in grade with light weight, recent form decent but trainer's 14-day record is moderate

runners_data.name: Ask Peter
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner but poor trainer form and 56 days layoff raise doubts about returning to best form

runners_data.name: Little Venice
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent recent win, strong trainer and represents the most consistent performer in the field

runners_data.name: Aquifolia
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 169-day break with headgear change, long absence is major concern despite ability

runners_data.name: Night Burlesque
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from struggling trainer with poor recent form including a pull-up, hard to recommend

runners_data.name: For Love Of Beauty
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with lowest rating and poor recent form, carries light weight but lacks any positive indicators

races.paceDynamic: Ask Peter will take this field along as the only confirmed front runner, with Dance Havana likely tracking in second as the sole prominent runner. This creates a sustainable tempo with no early pressure, allowing the large pack of hold-up horses (Little Venice, Miracles Do Happen, Bluenose Belle, Aquifolia, Night Burlesque, For Love Of Beauty) to settle behind. With minimal pace pressure early, this becomes a tactical affair where stamina and a strong finishing kick matter more than pure speed. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as they'll have plenty left in the tank after the sedate early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ask Peter sets his usual honest pace without pressure and the field comes home in a bunch
scenarios.body: The large pack of closers will have maximum energy reserves for the final hill climb, with the best stayers prevailing in a competitive finish. Little Venice and Bluenose Belle are perfectly positioned to capitalize on their preferred patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Duo Hold Sway
scenarios.trigger: If Ask Peter and Dance Havana steal a march by quickening the tempo approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: Their uncontested early position becomes decisive as the hold-up brigade struggles to make up ground on the testing Taunton hill. The two pace-setters can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes excessively slow with Ask Peter taking it very easy up front
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where the horse with the best turn of foot wins regardless of running style. This favours horses with proven acceleration like Little Venice who has shown speed over shorter trips.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Ask Peter fails to maintain his usual honest gallop or encounters jumping issues
scenarios.body: The race fragments with no clear tempo, creating chaos where any running style can prevail through good positioning. An outsider like Night Burlesque or Aquifolia could capitalize on the confusion.

watchPoints.text: Ask Peter's jumping - if the lone pace-setter makes errors early, the entire race dynamic collapses
Little Venice's position at halfway - needs to be within striking distance to utilize her proven finishing kick
Dance Havana's tactics - whether she tracks Ask Peter closely or drops back could determine if there's any pace pressure
Bluenose Belle's weight advantage - the 148lbs burden is significant and could prove decisive in a tight finish
Miracles Do Happen's jumping rhythm - recent 33-day break should have him sharp but needs to travel smoothly to contend

races.name: Stables Business Park Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Wicked Thoughts
runners_data.note: Front-runner with excellent recent form for Paul Nicholls, ideal tactical position with no genuine pace rivals

runners_data.name: Autonomous Cloud
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but concerning poor recent form and longest absence at 41 days for Harry Derham

runners_data.name: Anytrixwilldo
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the race shape, carries only 145lbs but Benjamin Macey's 5lb claim reduces experience factor

runners_data.name: Puddlesinthepark
runners_data.note: Hold-up style is major tactical disadvantage in a race lacking genuine early pace pressure

runners_data.name: Always Busy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good recent form, shortest break at 8 days and Christian Williams stable in form

runners_data.name: Moroder
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent runner with decent recent form but carries top weight at 168lbs which may tell late

races.paceDynamic: Wicked Thoughts will dominate from the front without serious pressure, as the other prominent runners (Autonomous Cloud, Anytrixwilldo, Always Busy, Moroder) are unlikely to challenge for the early lead over this extended trip. With only Puddlesinthepark committed to hold-up tactics, the pace will be moderate and sustainable through the early stages. The lack of genuine pace pressure means this race strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to Wicked Thoughts, while the hold-up horse Puddlesinthepark faces a significant tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Wicked Thoughts Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Wicked Thoughts maintains her jumping rhythm and isn't seriously challenged for the lead
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls-trained mare can dictate terms at her own pace and prove hard to peg back, especially with her excellent recent form. Her sustainable galloping style and 7-day freshness advantage become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can sit close enough to Wicked Thoughts and outjump her late
scenarios.body: Always Busy or Anytrixwilldo could benefit from the moderate pace by tracking the leader and having enough left for a late challenge. The lack of early pace pressure allows these horses to conserve energy for a telling move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and Puddlesinthepark gets the perfect run from the back
scenarios.body: The extended distance could play into Puddlesinthepark's hands if the front-runners go too slowly early and set up a sprint finish. However, this requires the pace to collapse significantly from the leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Errors Change Everything
scenarios.trigger: If Wicked Thoughts makes a crucial mistake at a fence when in command
scenarios.body: Any of the prominent runners tracking behind could capitalize on jumping errors from the leader to inherit the race. The extended trip increases the chances of costly mistakes affecting the outcome.

watchPoints.text: Wicked Thoughts must jump cleanly throughout as any significant error hands the initiative to the prominent trackers
Always Busy could be overbet given the 8-day turnaround but Christian Williams horses are running well currently
Puddlesinthepark needs the pace to completely collapse early to get competitive from her hold-up position
Anytrixwilldo's 5-claim jockey Benjamin Macey may struggle with tactical decisions in a small field lacking pace pressure
Autonomous Cloud's 41-day break and poor recent form make her vulnerable despite previous course winner credentials

races.name: Stag Environmental Polaris Exmoor Devon Somerset Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Just A Rose
runners_data.note: Natural front runner returning after 40-day break under champion trainer Nicholls, but recent form shows vulnerability when pressed for pace

runners_data.name: Earth King
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after long 217-day absence for in-form Mulholland stable, needs the run but class could shine through

runners_data.name: Inferno Sacree
runners_data.note: Consistent front runner in excellent form with 7lb claiming jockey, recent wins show stamina and determination over similar trips

runners_data.name: Al Sayah
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs strong pace to aim at, recent form solid and suits good ground conditions perfectly

races.paceDynamic: Just A Rose and Inferno Sacree will contest the early lead in this small field, with both natural front runners likely to engage from the start. Earth King will sit prominently behind the pace-setters, while Al Sayah will need to be produced with his customary late run from the rear. The dual pace angle should create a solid gallop over this testing 3m trip, potentially setting up the race for those who can sit off the speed. This race shape favours prominent runners and hold-up horses who can capitalize on the early pace battle between the two leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Benefits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If Just A Rose and Inferno Sacree go too hard early trying to establish dominance
scenarios.body: The leaders will weaken in the final half-mile, allowing Al Sayah to sweep past with his superior finishing kick. Earth King could also benefit from the strong pace if positioned well by O'Farrell.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates Solo
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gains an uncontested lead while the other falls back early
scenarios.body: Just A Rose or Inferno Sacree will control the tempo and have enough left to resist late challenges. The lack of sustained pressure allows the leader to dictate terms throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Times Move
scenarios.trigger: If Earth King positions perfectly behind the pace duel without getting involved
scenarios.body: O'Farrell can time his move to perfection as the leaders tire, striking at the optimal moment. Earth King's class and experience over the trip could prove decisive in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Favours Stayer
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong but one leader maintains stamina reserves
scenarios.body: Inferno Sacree's recent consistency and proven stamina could see him outlast Just A Rose in a genuine staying test. The sustained gallop plays to his strengths over this demanding distance.

watchPoints.text: Just A Rose may need the run after 40 days off and could be vulnerable if Inferno Sacree makes it a genuine test from the front
Earth King's fitness after 217 days away is questionable despite Mulholland's good strike rate with returning horses
Murray Dodd's 7lb claim could prove crucial for Inferno Sacree in a tight finish between similarly-rated opponents
Al Sayah needs the two front runners to go hard early or he may have too much ground to make up in the closing stages
Small field dynamics mean positioning errors will be magnified and tactical moves limited compared to larger fields

races.name: Mike's Seventieth Birthday Celebration Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Hall Lane
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with highest OR 100 but needs pace collapse and 29 days since last run may blunt his edge.

runners_data.name: Gata Ban
runners_data.note: Another hold-up type with headgear previously worn, solid record on similar going but 31-day gap concerning.

runners_data.name: Illogical Logic
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in good form with amateur jockey Murphy-Knight taking 7lb allowance, ideal tactical position.

runners_data.name: School For Scandal
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the pace setup, trainer Tickle running at just 20% strike rate recently but horse is consistent.

runners_data.name: Fat Sam
runners_data.note: Non-runner declared.

runners_data.name: Mcgregors Charge
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from 188-day layoff which is a major concern despite good historical record.

runners_data.name: Cave Article
runners_data.note: Front-runner with class edge but 231-day absence is risky, needs to be fresh enough to sustain early effort.

runners_data.name: Boys Of Wexford
runners_data.note: Co-leader likely to force pace but headgear visor suggests concentration issues and trainer Oliver struggling at 0/7.

races.paceDynamic: Cave Article and Boys Of Wexford will contest the early lead, with Cave Article likely to assert given his superior class and fresher jockey Tudor. Illogical Logic, School For Scandal and Mcgregors Charge will track close behind in prominent positions, creating a steady gallop rather than breakneck pace. The hold-up pair Hall Lane and Gata Ban will be delivered late but face a solid tempo throughout. This honest gallop strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leaders and kick when the pace lifts, rather than hold-up horses who need a collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays honest but competitive between Cave Article and Boys Of Wexford
scenarios.body: The tracking prominent horses get the perfect setup to strike turning for home as the leaders tire. Illogical Logic and School For Scandal are ideally positioned to capitalize on their superior fitness.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leaders Battle Home
scenarios.trigger: If Cave Article kicks clear early and Boys Of Wexford can't match the pace
scenarios.body: Cave Article gets an uncontested lead and proves too strong, while the prominent horses can't bridge the gap. His class edge and 231-day break means he's fresh enough to sustain the effort.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast trying to dominate each other
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final half-mile allowing Hall Lane and Gata Ban to sweep past tired leaders. Hall Lane's superior class rating of 100 makes him the primary beneficiary of this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Factor
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or mistakes disrupt the race flow significantly
scenarios.body: The jumping errors create gaps and confusion, allowing an outsider to capitalize on a cleaner round. School For Scandal's recent form improvement and lighter weight could prove decisive in a messy contest.

watchPoints.text: Cave Article's jumping after 231 days off - any early mistake ends his chance as the likely pace-setter
Mcgregors Charge's fitness after 188-day break - needs to travel strongly early to suggest he's ready
Hall Lane's position at halfway - if too far back when pace quickens he won't get there
Boys Of Wexford's jumping under pressure - headgear suggests issues and he'll be pressed throughout
Illogical Logic's position turning in - perfectly placed prominent racer with weight allowance could strike gold
